summary.name: CareJobs.Now
summary.one_liner: A free healthcare job search site that aggregates open nursing, allied health and care jobs from employer job boards, with posted pay shown where available.
keywords: job search for us healthcare workers
use_cases: Finding nursing and CNA jobs near a city
Comparing hourly pay for healthcare jobs by job, employer or state
Searching for part-time, PRN or night shift healthcare work
Finding remote healthcare jobs such as coding or care management
Setting up weekly email alerts for new care openings
summary.what_it_does: Aggregates about 445,000 open healthcare jobs, reading employer job boards nightly, along with USAJOBS and Adzuna listings for employers not read individually. Jobs are grouped into 17 categories such as registered nurses, therapists, physicians, CNAs and caregivers. Postings with a stated hourly rate are summarized into typical pay ranges, with a median of $35/hr across the site's data. Each listing links to the employer's own application page. Users can search by job, shift or status and subscribe to a weekly job alert email.
notable: Pay figures drawn from posted hourly rates across about 104,000 postings
Links directly to each employer's own application page
Some referral fees from staffing agencies and AI-training programs, disclosed on the page
Includes remote AI-training work for health professionals alongside clinical jobs
caveats: Referral fees may be paid to the site when users join certain staffing agencies, shift apps or AI-training programs through its links
Most listed jobs (about 282,942 of 445,168) post no hourly rate, so pay figures cover only a subset
Job counts and pay figures are a snapshot dated 28 Oct 2026
